The '''Tashtor sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered the [[Halm sector/Legends|Halm]], [[Narrant sector/Legends|Narrant]], [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi]], [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla]] and [[Marzoon sector/Legends|Marzoon sectors]] in the Mid Rim, as well as the [[Jidlor Marches/Legends|Jidlor Marches]].
